NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 20, 11:53 PM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 23.9 DraftKings points for $8,400, at Las Vegas. Amon-Ra St. Brown (18.8, $7,800) and Zay Flowers (17.4, $6,900) are next.

Puka Nacua is also the top value at the position: 2.84 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 20, 11:53 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 7

Puka Nacua, LAR at LV ($8,400)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 23.9 DraftKings points at $8,400, the 2nd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 5.1 points clear of Amon-Ra St. Brown. The model gives him 11.5 targets on 33.0 routes. The salary works out to 2.84 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 28 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 24.0 points with a simulated floor of 11.3 and a ceiling of 44.5, and he holds 25% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 47.5.

Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET vs GB ($7,800)

Amon-Ra St. Brown projects 2nd at the position with 18.8 DraftKings points at $7,800. The model gives him 9.9 targets on 34.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.41 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 28 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 18.7 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 39.0, and he holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3-point favorite at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 27.75 in a game totaled at 52.5.

Zay Flowers, BAL vs CIN ($6,900)

Zay Flowers projects 3rd at the position with 17.4 DraftKings points at $6,900. The model gives him 6.3 targets on 18.8 routes. The salary works out to 2.52 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 28 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Flowers averaged 17.4 points with a simulated floor of 5.8 and a ceiling of 37.4, and he holds 18% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Baltimore is a 2.5-point favorite at home against Cincinnati, with an implied team total of 27 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Value: Matthew Golden, GB at DET ($6,000)

Matthew Golden projects for 15.9 DraftKings points at $6,000, which works out to 2.65 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 28 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 7.8 targets on 32.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Golden averaged 16.0 points with a simulated floor of 5.0 and a ceiling of 36.5, and he holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Green Bay is a 3-point underdog on the road against Detroit, with an implied team total of 24.75 in a game totaled at 52.5.
